data.desc: Namib Minerals (Nasdaq: NAMM) is Driving a New Era in African Precious Metals Mining, combining established gold production with an ambitious vision for growth. Led by an experienced African management team, the company is advancing a pipeline of projects to expand production and build a diversified mining business. Operational discipline, local expertise and responsible development underpin Namib's commitment to creating lasting value for shareholders and the communities where it operates.
